title: One Strategy Does Not Fit All: Rethinking Data Labeling for Just-in-Time Vulnerability Prediction
title_zh: 一种策略无法适用所有场景：重新思考即时漏洞预测的数据标注

paragraphs.en: 实证研究表明即时漏洞预测的标注策略效果高度依赖下游任务，无普适最优策略。 Just-In-Time Vulnerability Prediction (JIT-VP) identifies security risks in code changes at commit time, enabling early feedback before vulnerabilities enter software systems. However, its practical reliability is challenged by the difficulty of constructing accurate labels. Multiple strategies with different trade-offs have been proposed to identify vulnerability-fixing commits (VFCs) and vulnerability-introducing commits (VICs) for dataset construction, leading to substantially different datasets. This makes it difficult to separate model performance from dataset construction. Moreover, real-world quality assurance requires not only classification but also prioritizing high-risk commits and localizing vulnerable causes. This paper presents an extensive empirical study of how labeling strategies affect these downstream tasks. We constructed 28 datasets using four VFC and four VIC labeling strategies across OpenSSL and Linux kernel, then evaluated six representative JIT-VP models for classification, prioritization, and localization. Our results show that labeling effectiveness is strongly task-dependent. Manual VFC labeling combined with vulnerability-specific VIC labeling provides the most reliable performance for classification and prioritization, significantly outperforming 11 of 15 alternatives. Meanwhile, precision-first VFC labeling combined with LLM-assisted VIC labeling performs best for localization, significantly outperforming 7 of 15 alternatives. These findings demonstrate that no single labeling strategy is universally optimal and highlight the importance of task-oriented dataset construction.
paragraphs.zh: 实证研究表明即时漏洞预测的标注策略效果高度依赖下游任务，无普适最优策略。即时漏洞预测在代码变更提交时识别安全风险，在漏洞进入软件系统之前提供早期反馈。 然而，其实用可靠性受到构建准确标签这一困难的挑战。 为了构建数据集，已有多种具有不同权衡的策略被提出用于识别漏洞修复提交（VFC）和漏洞引入提交（VIC），这导致了差异显著的数据集。 这使得很难将模型性能与数据集构建分离开来。 此外，现实世界的质量保障不仅需要分类，还需要对高风险提交进行优先级排序并定位漏洞成因。 本文对标注策略如何影响这些下游任务进行了广泛的实证研究。 我们在 OpenSSL 和 Linux 内核上使用四种 VFC 标注策略和四种 VIC 标注策略构建了 28 个数据集，然后评估了六个具有代表性的即时漏洞预测模型在分类、优先级排序和定位任务上的表现。 我们的结果表明，标注的有效性高度依赖于具体任务。 人工 VFC 标注结合漏洞专用的 VIC 标注在分类和优先级排序上提供了最可靠的性能，在 15 种替代方案中显著优于 11 种。 同时，精度优先的 VFC 标注结合 LLM 辅助的 VIC 标注在定位任务上表现最佳，在 15 种替代方案中显著优于 7 种。 这些发现表明，没有任何单一标注策略是普遍最优的，并凸显了面向任务的数据集构建的重要性。
